versions.subject: New detection - Linux Keylogging
versions.detection:
path_events:
    type: PATH
    name: 
    - '/etc/pam.d/system-auth'
    - '/etc/pam.d/password-auth'
tty_events:
     type:
     - 'TTY'
     - 'USER_TTY'
condition: path_events or tty_events
